title: Khair Ul Wara Ki Beti Ko Darbar
body:
Khair ul wara ki beti ko darbar bula ker mara geya madinay main
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Aliya Bibi ko is kay baba kay minber say jhooti keh ker bhi pukara geya Madinay main .
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Touheed kay badan ki toheen bhi hui hai kuch is tarah logo
Baandh ker rasiyon say jahan chaltay thay Sher e Khuda inhi rasto say guzara geya Madinay main .
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Saya na koi gumbad chand pathron kay neechay turbat hai Fatima ki
Ghair say kaisa gila rota hoga Baqiya main wo koi momin jo bechara geya Madinay main .
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Tooti hui pasliyon ko Jab daikhti thi Zahra roti thi bain ker kay
Main Sahifa thi wo apnay khaliq ki taharat ka jis ko Sarwar pay utara geya Madinay main.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Touqeer bhool gaye sub anbiya ki aabroo thi muqeem jis jaga per
Lakriyan lae gaen ghar tou jalna tha wo lekin pehlay dar ko bhi ukhara geya Madinay main.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Salman aur Fiza mojood thay wahin per wahin Ya Ali kharay thay
Samnay baito kay cheen ker Fatima say virsa jab tha tehreer ko phaara geya Madinay main.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Gayoor maa ka baita mar jata tamacho kay gham ko kaisay bhulata
Rooth ker aisa Samar nikla Shabir Madinay say lout ker phir na dobara geya Madinay main .
